title: RIC-401 Appendix D — Artifact Update Protocols
subtitle: How design intent artifacts stay alive at agent speed: in-place refinement, supersession with lineage, hypothesis-outcome annotation, pattern extraction.

nodes.label:
ARTIFACT UPDATE PROTOCOLS — "Design is never done."  Every artifact is versioned, status-tracked, lineage-preserving.
Decide UPDATE-IN-PLACE vs SUPERSEDE vs ANNOTATE vs EXTRACT based on the change shape.
Change to a design intent artifact

REFINEMENT
(small additive change:
type the field tighter,
add an example, sharper UT description)

MAJOR SHIFT
(replaces the approach:
whole-feature redesign, new UT,
IA restructure, ADR contradiction)

HYPOTHESIS OUTCOME
(user data flipped status to
CONFIRMED / REFUTED / PARTIAL
with new evidence)

CONFIRMED PATTERN EMERGES
(multiple inner-loop wins
show the same shape;
ready to promote to outer)

UPDATE IN PLACE
• bump version (1.0 → 1.1)
• update last_modified
• preserve hypothesis_id + supersedes_id (stay)
• git commit with refinement summary

SUPERSEDE WITH LINEAGE
• create NEW artifact (1.0 → 2.0)
• new artifact has supersedes_id = old.id
• OLD artifact stays — never deleted
• status of old: SUPERSEDED

ANNOTATE WITH OUTCOME
• append outcome record:
  status, date, evidence_refs[]
• append-only — old annotations
  stay (audit trail)
• may trigger SUPERSEDE if REFUTED

EXTRACT PATTERN to OUTER
• distill the reusable shape
• propose to design system (DESIGN.md)
• HCD lead + architect review
• merge → version-bump design system
• notify other tenants

ALWAYS:
• version + last_modified on every artifact
• status field: DRAFT / APPROVED / SUPERSEDED / DEPRECATED — never silent deletion
• CHANGELOG.md alongside design system (treat like code)
• PR review for any artifact change (treat docs like code)
• stale-detection cadence: quarterly design system audit, annual UT review with current research

NEVER:
• silent overwrite (UPDATE IN PLACE for refinements only — never to mask a major shift)
• delete superseded artifacts (lineage matters; the audit trail is the artifact)
• change status without dated evidence (CONFIRMED with no metrics is theater)
• extract a pattern without ≥2 confirmed instances (one-off ≠ pattern)
• promote outer-loop changes without HCD lead + architect review

EXTRACT is the LOAD-BEARING update.
It's how the Outer Design System grows from
inner-loop wins, keeping the system LIVING.
Without extraction, the design system ossifies.
